name: UNRED NIGHT
source: One night, a boy crosses paths with a mysterious white haired vampire girl, and his quiet life takes an unexpected turn. What begins as a strange encounter quickly becomes a tender and sweet romance.
translation: 一天晚上，一名男孩与一名神秘的白发吸血鬼女孩相遇，他平静的生活发生了意想不到的转变。一场奇怪的邂逅很快就变成了一段温柔甜蜜的浪漫。
